8. **Governing Law**: The Agreement is governed by the laws of [Your State].

9. **Entire Agreement**: This document replaces all previous agreements and understandings on the subject.

10. **Amendments**: Any changes must be in writing and signed by both parties.

Both parties acknowledge understanding and voluntarily accepting the Agreement.

Signed as of the Effective Date by [Your Company Name] - Disclosing Party [Recipient Name] - Receiving Party.

Either party may terminate this Agreement with [e.g., "30 days"] written notice if the other party breaches any term herein.

8. Governing Law:
This Agreement is governed by the laws of [State/Country, e.g., "California"].

    e) No Reverse Engineering: Receiving party shall not reverse engineer any provided items.

    a) Notification: Suspected breaches must be reported in writing by the non-breaching party.
